policies.name: Highest-APR priority
policies.explanation: Exhaust the highest effective-rate group before lower groups.
policies.limitation: Dispute protection takes precedence; deferred-window and request branches are separate.

policies.name: Descending remainder priority
policies.explanation: Compare every remaining higher/lower rate pair; equal rates remain unordered.

policies.name: Deferred-program applicability
policies.explanation: Runtime derives qualifying programs from conditional accrued interest and the grace/zero exclusions.
policies.limitation: External contract facts are trusted; this checks the proposed program classification.

policies.name: Ordinary default outside the window
policies.constraint: (regz_context.kind <> 'allocation' OR (regz_context.method <> 'default' OR (regz_context.active_programs = 0 OR regz_context.window_programs > 0 OR regz_context.ordinary_violations = 0)))
policies.description: P04: Ordinary default outside the window
policies.explanation: Active programs outside the priority window use ordinary ordering.

policies.name: Deferred-window priority
policies.explanation: Detect ordinary allocations while eligible priority-program capacity remains.
policies.limitation: Simultaneously eligible deferred balances form one unordered priority group; disputed capacity comes last.

policies.name: Remainder after deferred priority
policies.explanation: The ordinary balances left after the priority group retain descending effective-rate order.

policies.name: Optional deferred-program request
policies.constraint: (regz_context.kind <> 'allocation' OR (regz_context.method <> 'deferred_request' OR (regz_context.active_programs > 0 AND regz_context.issuer_elected AND regz_context.request_mismatches = 0)))
policies.explanation: A request may allocate among any account balances while a qualifying program applies.
policies.limitation: Targets need not themselves be deferred. Only recorded, specific instructions are supported.

policies.name: Optional secured-balance request
policies.constraint: (regz_context.kind <> 'allocation' OR (regz_context.method <> 'secured_request' OR (regz_context.unsecured_request_targets = 0 AND regz_context.issuer_elected AND regz_context.request_mismatches = 0)))
policies.explanation: Every positive requested amount must target a secured balance.
policies.limitation: Security-interest facts are externally established.

policies.name: Permitted snapshot date
policies.explanation: Both amounts and rates are read from the selected complete snapshot.
policies.limitation: Snapshots must be authoritative complete account snapshots.

policies.name: Consistent reference-day practice
policies.explanation: Compute the date from the effective practice's cycle-end, credit-date, or offset convention.
policies.limitation: Operational choice, not a complete interpretation of 'generally'.

policies.name: Permitted practice adjustments
policies.explanation: Changed conventions require a recorded authorization and effective date.
policies.limitation: Cannot determine legal acceptability of 'from time to time'; authorization evidence does not resolve that legal standard.

policies.name: Residual after historical snapshot
policies.explanation: After dispute/window priorities, exhaust historical lots before later lots.
policies.limitation: Generalization of the single later-purchase example; later lots use their payment-date APR.

policies.name: Minimize disputed reduction
policies.explanation: Compute reduction for minimum plus excess against all outstanding undisputed capacity.
policies.limitation: Dispute protection overrides request and program priority. Dispute merits are external.

policies.name: Allow unavoidable disputed residual
policies.explanation: When disputed reduction is unavoidable, require exhaustion of all other capacity. P17 separately rejects avoidable disputed reduction.

policies.name: Error-correction credit
policies.explanation: At completion, check each required principal/charge item against actual posted credits.
policies.limitation: Required charge attribution and checkpoint deadline come from external section 1026.13 requirements; this does not initiate a credit.

policies.name: Correction notice dispatch
policies.explanation: Require actual timely dispatch to the specified recipient, linked to the determination.
policies.limitation: Notice content certification is trusted external evidence; no autonomous dispatch or deadline scheduler.

policies.name: Zero allocation APR for deferred interest
policies.description: P23: Zero allocation APR for deferred interest
policies.explanation: Compare proposed effective APRs with the zero-or-snapshot-rate derivation.
policies.limitation: The contractual interest accrual rate is not changed.

policies.name: Interim payments irrelevant to applicability
policies.description: P25: Interim payments irrelevant to applicability
policies.explanation: Program classification does not depend on its interim-payment-required attribute.

policies.name: Grace-period exclusion
policies.explanation: The classifier excludes grace periods.
policies.limitation: Checks a proposed classification; does not add an allocation-priority obligation.

policies.name: Temporary-zero exclusion
policies.explanation: The classifier excludes temporary zero APR unless accrued interest may become payable.
policies.limitation: External rate-change legality is not checked.

policies.name: Correct counted cycles
policies.explanation: Compute the start from the latest two cycle due dates no later than expiration, not a supplied expected value.
policies.limitation: At least two actual cycles through the expiration cycle must be supplied.

policies.name: Early-expiration partial cycle
policies.explanation: Priority remains in effect after the two counted cycles until expiration.
policies.limitation: Expiration dates are inclusive contract payoff dates in this model.

policies.name: No request uses default
policies.explanation: A missing or unsubmitted request cannot activate an exception.
policies.limitation: Complete request capture is assumed.

policies.name: Unfulfillable request and replacement
policies.explanation: Check sums, nonnegative amounts, targets, capacities, and submitted replacement links.
policies.limitation: Operational definition of inability; other meanings of 'cannot comply' remain unresolved.

policies.name: Affirmative specific contact
policies.constraint: (regz_context.kind <> 'allocation' OR (regz_context.method = 'default' OR (regz_context.request_basis <> 'contact' OR (regz_context.affirmative AND regz_context.instruction_count > 0 AND regz_context.contact_channel))))
policies.explanation: Recognize oral/electronic/written contact with explicit structured instructions.
policies.limitation: Interpretation of a conversation into instructions is external evidence processing.

policies.name: Completed submitted request form
policies.constraint: (regz_context.kind <> 'allocation' OR (regz_context.method = 'default' OR (regz_context.request_basis <> 'form' OR (regz_context.form_completed AND regz_context.request_present AND regz_context.affirmative AND regz_context.instruction_count > 0))))
policies.explanation: An actual completed/submitted form, not default coupon text, supports the exception.

policies.name: Request to reallocate previous payment
policies.constraint: (regz_context.kind <> 'allocation' OR (regz_context.method = 'default' OR (regz_context.request_basis <> 'reallocation' OR (regz_context.prior_default_allocation AND regz_context.affirmative AND regz_context.contact_channel AND regz_context.instruction_count > 0))))
policies.description: P36: Request to reallocate previous payment
policies.explanation: Verify a prior accepted default allocation and a later submitted specific request.
policies.limitation: Caller supplies the authoritative pre-payment balance snapshot for replacement; replacement is atomic.

policies.name: Preprinted agreement is insufficient
policies.explanation: Reject reliance on agreement deemed consent; an independent contact is a different evidence record.

policies.name: Untouched preselection is insufficient
policies.explanation: Reject reliance on an untouched issuer-selected checkbox.

policies.name: Default payment coupon is insufficient
policies.description: P39: Default payment coupon is insufficient
policies.explanation: Reject reliance on default coupon text or selection.

policies.name: Imposed acceptance is insufficient
policies.explanation: Reject requests based on imposed acceptance.
policies.limitation: Whether a condition was imposed is externally evidenced.

supporting_entries.name: Excess-payment scope
supporting_entries.explanation: Only excess allocation enters rate-priority comparisons; minimum allocations are separate.
supporting_entries.limitation: Minimum accounting is supplied, not inferred by subtracting the full minimum from each payment.

supporting_entries.name: Minimum amount outside scope
supporting_entries.explanation: Accept the supplied minimum portion without deriving a minimum-payment formula.
supporting_entries.limitation: Other applicable law is outside this adapter.

supporting_entries.name: Minimum allocation outside scope
supporting_entries.explanation: Rate priority does not constrain minimum allocations; dispute protection still examines the whole payment.

supporting_entries.name: Optional minimum allocation method
supporting_entries.explanation: Either a rate-ordered or other minimum allocation is allowed.
supporting_entries.limitation: A permission is preserved by absence of an additional restriction.

supporting_entries.name: Equal-rate discretion
supporting_entries.explanation: Strict rate comparisons impose no FIFO/pro-rata tie breaker; stronger dispute/program rules remain.
supporting_entries.limitation: Uses the enumerated exceptions, not a claim to resolve every possible meaning of 'generally'.

supporting_entries.name: Grouped or separate balances
supporting_entries.explanation: Presentation may group rows; the underlying lots retain program, security, and dispute attributes.
supporting_entries.limitation: Do not merge away facts needed by other checks.

supporting_entries.name: Incorporated deferred-interest definition
supporting_entries.explanation: Local terms implement the explicit conditional-interest description.
supporting_entries.limitation: Full equivalence with section 1026.16(h)(2) and its commentary is not implemented or claimed.

supporting_entries.name: Issuer may decline requests
supporting_entries.explanation: Default mode remains available even when a valid request exists.
supporting_entries.limitation: No policy requires the issuer to elect the request branch.

supporting_entries.name: Decline requests failing issuer requirements
supporting_entries.explanation: Default mode remains available regardless of why the issuer declined.
supporting_entries.limitation: This permission does not require a separate rejection policy or mandate issuer requirements.
